example.title: Red Bridge (State Highway Bridge No. 809), Union Street over the Broadkill River

brief: Single-span town-centre bridge of 1916, 24 ft 7 in long and 34 ft wide, carrying two traffic lanes and a sidewalk each side on concrete-encased steel girders under a concrete slab. Highly embellished: white rock-faced (rusticated) concrete end pylons carry bronze plaques (the bridge name and year with the county levy court and engineer; a later state rebuilding), and a diamond-lattice metal railing runs between them. Lined by two- and three-storey stucco commercial buildings with hipped tile-style roofs, street lights and a flagpole; the river is walled in concrete between buildings.

traits.deck: concrete slab on concrete-encased steel girders

names.plate: HERON BRIDGE · THIS BRIDGE BUILT 1916 BY THE COUNTY BOARD · A. L. MORRIS, ENGINEER
